text:
mira: Heads up — proposal to add a coalescer stage in metering ingest to batch micro-credits within 500ms windows. Wanted initial feedback on tradeoffs (latency vs reconciliation accuracy).

sam: 500ms okay? our realtime dashboards expect <200ms for credit visibility.

jon: If we coalesce at 500ms we reduce write amplification by ~3x on billing DB. But it introduces attribution uncertainty for simultaneous multi-model requests.

mira: Right. I was thinking we could emit an `approximate` flag on early credits and then reconcile with audit events later.

alex: How would the audit reconcile work? Do we keep raw events in cold store? What's the cost impact?

tasha: Cold store yes (S3). Keep raw per-request envelope for 30d. Reconcile job diffs coalesced credits vs raw and emits correction deltas.

sam: Concern: can corrections be applied idempotently? We've seen races with shard keys before. Need deterministic causality keys.

jon: We can generate a deterministic provenance id: `sha256(client_id + request_id + model_version + seq)`. Use that as dedupe key in the finalizer.

billing-bot: billing-bot: Notice: last reconcile reduced invoice mismatch by 2.1% — good sign :thumbsup:

mira: Question on windowing strategy: fixed time windows vs per-customer/session coalescing. Fixed windows are simpler but can split bursts for a single customer across boundaries.

alex: Per-customer sliding windows are heavier but yield better accuracy. Maybe hybrid: 200ms fixed + per-customer burst extension up to 1s.

jon: Hybrid sounds doable. Implementation note: coalescer service maintains per-customer buffers + a timer heap; eviction via LRU when many customers.

tasha: Edge case: tiny tenants with infrequent requests — coalescing delays may make credits appear later and confuse support. Need Console UX to show 'pending credits' state.

sam: Also surface a 'reconciliation pending' metric and expose per-tenant credit visibility P50/P95.

mira: Action items: I'll draft a short RFC with hybrid coalescer design, audit reconciliation flow, and idempotency keys. @jon to prototype buffer design. @tasha to draft Console UX copy. @alex to cost estimate cold storage + reconcile compute. Ping back by EOW? :calendar:

jon: On it — I'll simulate a 1M request replay and measure correction deltas.

tasha: I'll mock UI copy tomorrow.

mira: Cool, thanks everyone. tagging this thread `coalescer-proposal` for tracking.
